summary: The inspected official paper, dashboard, and three official ZIPs do not disclose an exhaustive SOC-code-to-quintile membership. A public reconstruction is feasible but is not exact BCC membership.

blocker.claim_impact: YAX may report an independently reconstructed public-rule bridge but cannot claim exact BCC occupation-group replication or membership identity.
